MISC

Hej there, and welcome to my blog.

This space is there as my personal memory for things that I either happen to look up frequently (like e.g. how to get WIFI working on ICE trains in germany :S) or just find interesting enough to write down. There is no plan for a regular schedule or focus on specific topics.

To keep it short: This is a blog which is mostly for myself, but if anyone else finds something useful, it is a nice bonus.

Best, Gregor
